# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 48 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 39 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_048_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 48

**1** Jesus said: "If two make peace [еірнн] with one another in this one house [нне], they will say to the mountain [тоу], 'Move away!' and it will move away [паране]."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *еірнн*: peace, reconciliation; Greek loan-word εἰρήνη
- *нне*: house, household; "in this one house" = in the same dwelling/community
- *паране*: to pass away, move; the mountain removes itself
- cf. Matt 17:20; 21:21; Mark 11:23; Luke 17:6 — the mountain-moving faith saying
- Thomas's version: the condition is not faith (as in Matthew/Mark) but peace/reconciliation between two people in a household
- The unification/peace theme connects to Sayings 4, 11, 22, 23
